title: gene2dis/BugBuster pipeline parameters
description: Bacterial Unraveling and metaGenomic Binning with Up-Scale Throughput, Efficient and Reproducible

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with information about the samples you want to analyse before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 4 columns (sample, r1, r2, s), and a header row.

output.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

pipeline_options.title: Pipeline execution options
pipeline_options.description: Control which pipeline steps to run.

quality_control.description: Enable quality control and host read filtering steps.

assembly_mode.help_text: Choose 'assembly' for individual sample assembly, 'coassembly' to combine all samples, or 'none' to skip assembly.

taxonomic_profiler.description: Software for taxonomic profiling at read level.

include_binning.description: Enable metagenomic binning and refinement steps.

read_arg_prediction.description: Enable ARG and ARGV gene prediction at read level using KARGA and KARGVA.

contig_tax_and_arg.description: Enable contig-level taxonomy and ARG prediction using BlobTools and DeepARG.

contig_level_metacerberus.description: Enable contig-level functional annotation with MetaCerberus.

contig_level_functional.description: Enable the contig-level functional annotation branch (shared Pyrodigal gene calling + eggNOG-mapper v3 + run_dbcan v5 CAZy annotation + featureCounts gene abundance + MicrobeCensus average genome size + study-level TPM and CPGE summary tables). Requires an assembly, and a singularity/apptainer container engine while eggNOG-mapper v3 is in beta.

mag_level_functional.description: Enable MAG-level functional annotation: Bakta annotation of every refined bin (per-bin GFF3/GBFF/FAA/FNA/TSV). Requires --include_binning and at least two --binners, so that only MetaWRAP quality-filtered bins are annotated. Bins are expected to be bacterial.

arg_bin_clustering.description: Enable ARG gene prediction and clustering for horizontal gene transfer inference.

min_read_sample.description: Minimum number of reads required per sample after QC filtering.

rgi_prediction.description: Enable RGI AMR gene prediction with pathogen-of-origin analysis.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Options for reference databases. Use automatic downloads or provide custom paths.

phiX_index.description: PhiX genome index selection for automatic download.

host_db.description: Host genome database for read filtering.

gtdbtk_db.description: GTDB-TK database release version. The pinned GTDB-Tk 2.7.x accepts only GTDB R232 data (R220/R226 require GTDB-Tk <= 2.6.1).

eggnog_db.description: Built-in eggNOG 7 data key for eggNOG-mapper v3 (see config/databases.config).

custom_eggnog_db.description: Path to custom eggNOG 7 data directory in the emapper-3.0 layout: eggnog.db (plus .fieldpresence.bin and .taxids.bin caches), eggnog.taxa.db (plus .traverse.pkl), eggnog_proteins.dmnd, go-basic.obo.

dbcan_db.description: Built-in dbCAN database release key for run_dbcan v5 (see config/databases.config).

custom_dbcan_db.description: Path to custom dbCAN database directory in the run_dbcan v5 layout: CAZy.dmnd, dbCAN.hmm, dbCAN-sub.hmm, fam-substrate-mapping.tsv.

bakta_db.description: Built-in Bakta database key: v6.0-full (default) or v6.0-light (see config/databases.config). The light database changes annotation results; selecting it is recorded in provenance and never done automatically.

custom_bakta_db.description: Path to custom Bakta database directory (schema 6 layout: version.json, amrfinderplus-db/, and the Bakta annotation databases).

cog_db.description: Built-in NCBI COG definitions table used to map the COG ids eggNOG-mapper reports in COG_category to COG functional-category letters (contig functional branch): cog-24 (see config/databases.config; ~410 KB).

custom_cog_db.description: Path to a local NCBI COG definitions table (cog-24.def.tab layout: COG id, category letters, ...); skips the download. Must cover the COG ids of the eggNOG database in use.

custom_kraken_db.description: Path to custom Kraken2 database directory.

custom_sourmash_db.description: Paths to custom Sourmash database files [kmer_file, lineages_file].

custom_checkm2_db.description: Path to custom CheckM2 database file.

custom_gtdbtk_db.description: Path to custom GTDB-TK database directory.

custom_deeparg_db.description: Path to custom DeepARG database directory.

custom_blast_db.description: Path to custom BLAST NT database directory.

custom_taxdump_files.description: Path to custom NCBI taxdump directory.

custom_karga_db.description: Path to custom KARGA database FASTA file.

custom_kargva_db.description: Path to custom KARGVA database FASTA file.

karga_db.description: Built-in KARGA reference database key (see config/databases.config).

kargva_db.description: Built-in KARGVA reference database key (see config/databases.config).

blast_db.description: Built-in BLAST nucleotide database key (see config/databases.config).

taxdump_files.description: Built-in NCBI taxdump files key (see config/databases.config).

custom_decontamination_index.description: Path to a pre-built combined phiX + host Bowtie2 index (skips the local build).

custom_phiX_fasta.description: Custom phiX FASTA used to build the combined decontamination index.

custom_host_fasta.description: Custom host genome FASTA (plain or gzipped) used to build the combined decontamination index.

custom_rgi_card_db.description: Path to a pre-prepared CARD database for RGI.

custom_rgi_wildcard.description: Path to a WildCARD variants archive to combine with the CARD database.

fastp_options.title: Fastp options
fastp_options.description: Parameters for read quality filtering with Fastp.

fastp_n_base_limit.description: Maximum number of N bases allowed in a read.

fastp_unqualified_percent_limit.description: Maximum percentage of unqualified bases allowed.

fastp_qualified_quality_phred.description: Phred quality score threshold for qualified bases.

fastp_cut_front_window_size.description: Window size for cutting from front of reads.

fastp_cut_front_mean_quality.description: Mean quality threshold for front cutting.

fastp_cut_right_window_size.description: Window size for cutting from right of reads.

fastp_cut_right_mean_quality.description: Mean quality threshold for right cutting.

bracken_read_len.description: Read length for Bracken abundance estimation.

bracken_tax_level.description: Taxonomic level for Bracken (D=Domain, P=Phylum, C=Class, O=Order, F=Family, G=Genus, S=Species).

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Parameters for genome assembly and contig filtering.

bbmap_length.description: Minimum contig length after BBMap filtering.

binners.description: Comma-separated list of binners to use. Options: comebin, semibin, metabat2. At least one required. If >=2 selected, MetaWRAP refinement is used.

metabat_maxP.description: Maximum percentage of good contigs for MetaBAT2.

metabat_minCV.description: Minimum coefficient of variation for MetaBAT2.

metabat_minCVSum.description: Minimum sum of coefficient of variation for MetaBAT2.

metawrap_completeness.description: Minimum bin completeness threshold for MetaWRAP.

metawrap_contamination.description: Maximum bin contamination threshold for MetaWRAP.

deeparg_options.title: DeepARG options
deeparg_options.description: Parameters for ARG prediction with DeepARG.

deeparg_min_prob.description: Minimum probability threshold for DeepARG predictions.

deeparg_arg_alignment_identity.description: Minimum alignment identity percentage for DeepARG.

deeparg_arg_num_alignments_per_entry.description: Number of alignments per entry for DeepARG.

bowtie2_options.title: Bowtie2 alignment options
bowtie2_options.description: Parameters for Bowtie2 read alignment and filtering.

bowtie_score_min.description: Minimum alignment score function for Bowtie2.

bowtie_k.description: Number of alignments to report for Bowtie2.

bowtie_N.description: Number of mismatches allowed in seed for Bowtie2.

bowtie_R.description: Number of re-seeding attempts for Bowtie2.

taxonomy_visualization_options.title: Taxonomy visualization options
taxonomy_visualization_options.description: Parameters for taxonomic visualization and output formatting.

taxonomy_plot_levels.description: Comma-separated list of taxonomic levels to plot.

taxonomy_top_n_taxa.description: Number of top taxa to display in plots.

create_phyloseq_rds.description: Generate R phyloseq RDS files for downstream analysis.

databases_dir.description: Directory for storing downloaded databases (separate from results output).

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text:
If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error. These options allow you to cap the maximum resources requested by any single job so that the pipeline will run on your system.

Note that you can not _increase_ the resources requested by any job using these options. For that you will need your own configuration file. See [the nf-core website](https://nf-co.re/usage/configuration) for details.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process. Should be an integer e.g. `--max_cpus 1`

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_memory '8.GB'`

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_time '2.h'`

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

store_clean_reads.description: Publish decontaminated reads to <output>/clean_reads/ (publishing, not caching: -resume is the cache).

trace_report_suffix.description: Timestamp suffix for the execution timeline/report/trace/dag file names.

rgi_options.title: RGI options
rgi_options.description: Parameters for RGI AMR prediction with pathogen-of-origin (used when --rgi_prediction).

rgi_card_version.description: CARD version to download: 'latest' or a specific version.

rgi_include_wildcard.description: Include WildCARD variants for extended allelic diversity.

rgi_min_kmer_coverage.description: Minimum k-mer coverage for pathogen-of-origin prediction.

metacerberus_options.title: MetaCerberus options
metacerberus_options.description: Parameters for MetaCerberus functional annotation (used when --contig_level_metacerberus).

metacerberus_hmm.description: HMM databases for MetaCerberus (quoted comma-separated list).

metacerberus_minscore.description: Minimum HMM score for MetaCerberus annotations.

functional_annotation_options.title: Functional annotation options
functional_annotation_options.description: Parameters for the contig-level functional annotation branch (used when --contig_level_functional).

featurecounts_multimap.description: featureCounts multi-mapping policy for gene quantification: 'primary' counts primary alignments only, 'all' counts every reported alignment (-M), 'none' excludes multi-mapping reads entirely.

microbecensus.description: Run MicrobeCensus on host-removed reads to estimate average genome size and genome equivalents, enabling copies-per-genome-equivalent (CPGE) normalization alongside TPM. Failure is non-fatal: affected samples fall back to TPM-only.

functional_cazy.description: Run run_dbcan CAZy annotation on the predicted proteins when the contig functional branch is enabled. Adds db=dbcan rows to the gene/function tables and dedicated function_wide_cazy_dbcan_* matrices alongside the eggNOG-derived CAZy calls.

dbcan_consensus.description: Which dbCAN calls feed aggregation: 'recommended' uses the tool's Recommend Results column (calls supported by at least 2 of DIAMOND/dbCAN HMM/dbCAN-sub), 'any' uses the union of the per-tool calls.

cloud_hpc_profile_options.title: Cloud & HPC profile options
cloud_hpc_profile_options.description: Parameters consumed by the aws/gcp/azure/slurm profiles (conf/*.config). The *_workdir parameters are required when their profile is active.

aws_workdir.description: S3 work directory (required with -profile aws), e.g. s3://my-bucket/work

aws_cli_path.description: Path to the aws CLI on the Batch AMI

gcp_workdir.description: GCS work directory (required with -profile gcp), e.g. gs://my-bucket/work

azure_workdir.description: Azure Blob work directory (required with -profile azure), e.g. az://my-container/work
